zh.title: 发布说明
items: **0.1.0-rc.39** 供负责人测试 rc.38（`0d47fbdad`）之后合入的修复：巡检与流式卡顿、已死执行实例的停机收尾、provider 诊断、Windows 存储引导与圆角图标，以及读取对话时的居中占位。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 修复与改进
items: #294（`99e45720b`）：给超过 100ms 的主进程定时器、渲染长任务、事件循环延迟、流式 send、计划写盘字节和 30 秒巡检分段留下诊断。这些行不含计划正文或标识。诊断安装失败不能拖垮 Electron 启动。
#295（`ffeab1b0b`）：30 秒巡检复用未变化计划的归一化结果，并按 planId 读取，不再按计划数平方重读目录。协调版本不变时跳过续跑全表扫描；未变化的协调总账不再每次重建。
#296（`cb7e14c96`）：流式只改正文且前缀引用不变时复用上一份行，不再重扫整段历史。处置、顺序和窗口与全量结果一致。
#297（`072421063`，与 Knowledge #127 / ADR 124 成对）：已死执行实例按本机身份元组收尾，不再把裸 pid 或旧纪元当成原进程已死。主 Bot 经宿主授权卡确认后，当前任务列表和协作列表不再显示该条。内部索引留给诊断，日常界面不展示「待核实」。不写 `stopReceipt`，不释放 claim，也不把计划改成已取消。
#298（`fc2119e91`，与 Knowledge #128 / ADR 30 成对）：聊天、Responses 和 chat adapter 共用受限的安全诊断读取。SDK 事件可以带上可选诊断，不发出原始响应体或提示回显。既有溢出类别、明确的 403 域名拒绝和 model-not-found 引导保留。
#299（`e2b268efe`）：Windows 上存储 worker 的 require 基址改为当前工作目录下的绝对路径。文件和目录 fsync 在 Windows 使用可写句柄，POSIX 仍用只读句柄。协调恢复的清单键改为 POSIX 分隔符。
#300（`f66734476`）：Windows 的 exe、任务栏和安装器图标改为圆角遮罩，四角透明，对齐 macOS Dock 的形状。macOS icns 与 Linux 图标未改。
#301（`0667f967f`）：空会话还在读取时，头像和「正在读取对话」放在对话列正中，字号和字重加大，高光从一端扫到另一端。减少动效和强制色彩下停掉扫光。工作现场的小字状态共用这套扫光，不改它们的布局。
同步双语发布说明与站点更新日志。义务跟进写入把协调格式下限抬到 11；本版仍可读既有格式 9 的数据。更新前完整备份。Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 按同一版本说明升级。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 升级与验证范围
items: #297 的授权卡由负责人在含该头的候选上记为手测通过。合成用例覆盖确认前后的列表退出。隔离 Electron 里的真实点击不在 CI 内。
#299 的 Windows 实机验证记在该 PR：新建 bot 后对话可以读出，恢复可以到达 ready。打包安装器上的手感未在本版发布流程里复测。
#301 在该 PR 的 Electron 里测量过居中和扫光。打包应用未复测。
本版不宣称 P3、内网 Gateway、远程配对或真实打包 Electron 手感已经交付。

en.title: Release notes
items: **0.1.0-rc.39** is for owner testing of the fixes landed after rc.38 (`0d47fbdad`): inspection and streaming stalls, stop settlement for a dead execution instance, provider diagnostics, Windows storage bootstrap and the rounded icon, and the centered conversation-loading placeholder. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: #294 (`99e45720b`): record diagnostics for main-process timers over 100ms, renderer long tasks, event-loop delay, streaming send, plan-write bytes, and the 30-second inspection stages. These lines omit plan bodies and identifiers. A failure while installing the diagnostics cannot take down Electron startup.

#295 (`ffeab1b0b`): the 30-second inspection reuses normalization for an unchanged plan and reads by planId, so it no longer rereads the directory once per plan per plan. An unchanged coordination revision skips the full resume scan, and an unchanged coordination ledger is not rebuilt every time.

#296 (`cb7e14c96`): when a stream only changes the body and the prefix references are unchanged, reuse the previous row instead of rescanning the whole history. Disposition, order, and the window stay the same as a full projection.

#297 (`072421063`, paired with Knowledge #127 / ADR 124): a dead execution instance settles from the local identity tuple. A bare pid or an old epoch is no longer treated as proof that the original process is dead. After the main bot confirms the host authorization card, the item leaves the current task list and the collaboration list. The internal index stays available for diagnostics, and everyday UI does not show a 待核实 section. This does not write a `stopReceipt`, does not release the claim, and does not mark the plan cancelled.

#298 (`fc2119e91`, paired with Knowledge #128 / ADR 30): chat, Responses, and the chat adapter share one bounded safe diagnostic reader. SDK events may carry optional diagnostics and do not emit raw bodies or prompt echoes. Established overflow categories, explicit 403 domain denials, and model-not-found guidance stay in place.

#299 (`e2b268efe`): the embedded storage worker resolves its require base from an absolute path under the current working directory, so Windows no longer receives a drive-less file URL. File and directory fsync use a writable handle on Windows and a read-only handle on POSIX. Coordination recovery inventory keys use POSIX separators.
#300 (`f66734476`): the Windows exe, taskbar, and installer icon use a rounded mask with transparent corners, matching the macOS Dock shape. The macOS icns and the Linux icon are unchanged.

#301 (`0667f967f`): while an empty conversation is still loading, the avatar and “正在读取对话” sit in the center of the conversation column, with a larger weight and a highlight that sweeps from one end of the text to the other. Reduced motion and forced colors stop the sweep. The work panel’s smaller status text shares the sweep and keeps its layout.

Update bilingual release notes and the website changelog. An obligation follow-up write raises the coordination format floor to 11. This build can still read existing format 9 data. Keep a complete backup before updating. Upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI, and Gateway according to the same release instructions. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: The owner recorded a hand test of the #297 authorization card on a candidate that contained that head. Synthetic cases cover the list exit before and after confirmation. A real click inside isolated Electron is not part of CI.

The Windows machine check for #299 is recorded on that PR: after creating a bot, the conversation can be read and recovery can reach ready. The feel of the packaged installer was not retested in this release flow.
#301 measured centering and the highlight sweep in Electron on that PR. The packaged app was not retested.
This release does not mean P3, an intranet Gateway, remote pairing, or a real packaged Electron feel shipped.
